digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command — lock health audit
propositions: Operator has no diagnostic surface to inspect who holds a lock, whether the holder is alive, or how long it has been held; rebar doctor must expose held/free state, owner identity from v2 stamp, holder liveness, hold age, and staleness for each lock leg.

Lock health checks must reuse existing primitives (write_lock_is_busy, lock_owner stamp parsing, liveness verdict, lock age, staleness authority) without re-deriving logic or inventing second staleness heuristics.

A stale or orphaned lock (dead holder or timestamp-aged beyond the wall-clock ceiling) must produce a FINDING and exit code 1; a held lock with a live holder must remain INFO and not affect exit code.
Doctor must be read-only: lock inspection never mutates lock dirs, owner files, or drain lock files, and --repair never touches locks.
JSON output must carry lock state and findings keyed as 'locks' and 'lock_findings', conforming to the updated doctor.schema.json, and help text must be regenerated into docs/cli-reference.md.
